scope: Short East Dead-Drop chapter; not final game or ten-minute acceptance

fixes: The legacy '★ DELIVERY COMPLETE ★ / R to reset' banner persists through the entire east-dead-drop chapter (frames 003/009/010/011) and stacks over the HEALTH/WANTED panel, so the screen shows a stale completion notice contradicting the active objective. Clear it (or move it below the main objective panel) once the new RouteMission activates.

The legacy green Beacon/BeaconRing at (1, ~0.2-0.74, 26) still glows brightly right beside the car at t=15.2s while the objective reads 50m — a bright green goal-like cue at zero distance next to a '50m away' instruction is misleading, especially since green is also the cache's completed color. Dim/remove completed legacy markers so the cyan cache is the sole goal cue.

Dark HUD panels clip off the top canvas edge in frames 011 and 012 (cut-off empty rectangles at the top border), and the health/notification boxes overlap each other. Fix panel layout/clamping so boxes do not overlap or slide off-screen.

Completion camera at t=33.10 (frame-011) is at ground level, edge-on to the cache with the car roof blocking the frame; pull the camera up/back on chapter completion so the placed cache and vehicle are both legible under the 'COMPLETE' banner.

Proof gap: no frame at the exact ~32.53s F-press moment (only bracketed by 30.97 prompt and 33.10 complete). Capture one frame showing the actor at the cache mid-placement to close the visual-proof limitation.
review.summary: The scoped mission-complete check is supported by coherent frame+trace evidence for the NEW east cache chapter, not the legacy leg. Trace anchors (activation 14.35s, vehicle arrival 30.20s, E exit 30.63s, F completion 32.53s, R reset 34.03s) match the frames: t=15.2 shows driving with "Drive to the cache (50m)" (correct distance to the new (50,.14,18) cache, while the vehicle is 1.1m from the already-completed legacy pad); t=30.27 shows the driving approach to the cyan cache marker at 5m; t=30.97 shows the actual on-foot approach with the visible blocky actor beside the cache and "Walk to the cache (3m) / Press F"; t=33.10 shows "EAST DEAD-DROP COMPLETE" with the cache marker having flipped cyan→green (placement state change); t=34.60 shows a genuine post-reset state (health 100, yellow parcel back on the street, courier grab objective, legacy delivery banner gone). The exact F-press instant (~32.53s) has no dedicated frame, but it is tightly bracketed by the 3m "Press F" prompt and the completion/marker-change frame, so the interaction is visually evidenced rather than merely asserted. The main objective panel is readable and non-overlapping in every frame. Remaining defects are HUD/marker readability and camera polish, which stay open as visual findings and do not block this mission-core scope.
